The '''Dark Reliquary''' was an ancient tomb built in the [[Flamewood]] in the [[Old Paths]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]], it was raided by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for valuable artifacts, and a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] fought through the droids to recover artifacts for [[Scratch (individual)|Scratch]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Reliquary appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it is the location of the Smuggler-class mission "Buyer's Remorse" on Voss.<ref name="TOR" />
